name: Star Wrath
description:
About This Game

The Earth has been destroyed. Only the debris floating in space remind us of its former glory. Humanity has lost its home. There are no more flags, no more laws. Only the Echo is left after civilization. And space doesn’t hold salvation; it only demands a price. The lone Wanderers will have to pay it.

Star Wrath is a multiplayer space extraction-action where you design your own ship, fight other space raiders for resources in PvP and PvE session battles and extract the loot you’ve collected from the map.

Experiment with your ship design, improve and adapt it to your play style, but don’t forget about the hull durability and modular destruction. Travel to the outskirts of the solar system to get rare materials, outsmart ruthless opponents and return to safety, if you can. Hide in space nebulae, ambush unsuspecting enemies, and conquer the realistic physics of open space maneuvering. Take on the challenge and fight in a world of lawlessness and brutality where every raid could be your last.

Engage in relentless fights in various corners of the solar system of the future. Fight solo or join other space raiders to dominate the battlefield.

From nimble interceptors to heavily armored fighters, assemble your ship from various modules to suit your play style or improve preset blueprints as needed.

All modules and structural parts are very elaborately designed so that your ship will look nice and realistic.

Every part of your ship can be damaged or destroyed. The hull takes the first hits, but once the core is exposed, survival becomes a real challenge.


Use space anomalies to your advantage. Hide from enemy scanners, launch surprise attacks, or disappear into the mist with stolen resources.

Each pilot has a unique set of skills that can change the course of battle. Harvest DNA samples from the bodies of fallen enemies to get access to their abilities.

The mass of your ship, engine types, and modular configurations impact inertia, speed, and maneuverability. Balance firepower, mobility, and armor to suit your combat style.
short_desc: Star Wrath is a multiplayer space extraction-action where you design your own ship and fight other players for resources in intense PvP and PvE battles.
